panels.description: Monitored services currently reporting process_online_status = 0.
panels.title: Offline services

panels.description: Failed TCP, ping, or HTTP probes, unexpected HTTP status codes, and TLS certificates with less than seven days remaining.

targets.expr: label_replace((probe_tcp_success{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} == 0), "issue", "TCP probe failed", "host", ".*") or label_replace((probe_ping_success{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} == 0), "issue", "Ping probe failed", "host", ".*") or label_replace((probe_http_success{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} == 0), "issue", "HTTP probe failed", "target", ".*") or label_replace((probe_http_status_code{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} < 200 or probe_http_status_code{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} >= 400), "issue", "Unexpected HTTP status", "target", ".*") or label_replace(((probe_http_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} >= 0) and (probe_http_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} < 604800)), "issue", "TLS certificate < 7 days", "target", ".*")

panels.title: Probe and certificate anomalies

panels.description: Nodes breaching fleet thresholds: CPU 85%, memory 90%, swap 85%, disk 90%, system file descriptors 80%, or failing SMART health.

targets.expr: label_replace((avg by (instance) (system_cpu_usage_percentage{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}) >= 85), "issue", "CPU >= 85%", "instance", ".*") or label_replace((100 * sum by (instance) (system_memory_usage_bytes{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}) / clamp_min(sum by (instance) (system_total_memory_bytes{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}), 1) >= 90), "issue", "Memory >= 90%", "instance", ".*") or label_replace((100 * sum by (instance) (system_swap_usage_bytes{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}) / clamp_min(sum by (instance) (system_total_swap_bytes{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}), 1) >= 85), "issue", "Swap >= 85%", "instance", ".*") or label_replace((100 * system_disk_usage_bytes{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",disk=~"$disk"} / clamp_min(system_total_disk_bytes{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",disk=~"$disk"}, 1) >= 90), "issue", "Disk >= 90%", "instance", ".*") or label_replace((100 * sum by (instance) (system_open_file{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}) / clamp_min(sum by (instance) (system_open_file_limit{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}), 1) >= 80), "issue", "System FDs >= 80%", "instance", ".*") or label_replace((system_disk_smart_health_status{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",disk=~"$disk"} == 0), "issue", "SMART health failed", "instance", ".*")

panels.title: Node resource anomalies

panels.description: Processes or JVMs breaching fleet thresholds: process CPU 80%, process memory 20%, process file descriptors 80%, old generation 85%, GC time 10%, safepoint overhead 10%, or active JIT failures.

targets.expr: label_replace((process_cpu_usage{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",container=~"$container",process_name=~"$process"} >= 80), "issue", "Process CPU >= 80%", "instance", ".*") or label_replace((process_memory_usage_percentage{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",container=~"$container",process_name=~"$process"} >= 20), "issue", "Process memory >= 20%", "instance", ".*") or label_replace((100 * process_open_file{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",container=~"$container",process_name=~"$process"} / clamp_min(process_open_file_limit{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",container=~"$container",process_name=~"$process"}, 1) >= 80), "issue", "Process FDs >= 80%", "instance", ".*") or label_replace((100 * jstat_gc_metrics{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",container=~"$container",process_name=~"$process",metric_name="OU"} / ignoring(metric_name) clamp_min(jstat_gc_metrics{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",container=~"$container",process_name=~"$process",metric_name="OC"}, 1) >= 85), "issue", "Old generation >= 85%", "instance", ".*") or label_replace((100 * rate(jstat_gc_metrics{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",container=~"$container",process_name=~"$process",metric_name="GCT"}[$__rate_interval]) >= 10), "issue", "GC time >= 10%", "instance", ".*") or label_replace((100 * jstat_runtime_metrics{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",container=~"$container",process_name=~"$process",metric_name="SafepointOverhead"} >= 10), "issue", "Safepoint overhead >= 10%", "instance", ".*") or label_replace((rate(jstat_compiler_metrics{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",container=~"$container",process_name=~"$process",metric_name=~"Failed|Invalid"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0), "issue", "JIT failure detected", "instance", ".*")
